meta.source: Wikipedia: European Union Customs Union (tables for non-EU participants and bilateral unions), plus EU accession dates from the EU snapshot
meta.permalink_note: Canonical title URL, not an oldid permalink: the research tool returned page text without revision ids. Pin an oldid at the next review.
meta.semantics: from = first day in the customs union; to = last day, inclusive
meta.eu_members_rule: from = max(EU accession date, 1968-07-01); founders therefore start 1968-07-01. [Likely]
meta.gb_end_note: UK left the EU 2020-01-31; the page says the UK is no longer in the customs union and transition ended 2020-12-31. Northern Ireland arrangements (Windsor Framework) are NOT modelled.

partial_scope.SM: bilateral union (Agreement on Cooperation and Customs Union)
partial_scope.MC: integral part of the EU customs territory via the Franco-Monegasque Customs Convention

imprecise_dates.MC: Wikipedia gives only the year 1968; 1968-07-01 aligned to the EUCU establishment. [Guess]

excluded.GI: Gibraltar: bilateral customs union signed 2026-07-14, provisionally applied from 2026-07-15, entry into force TBD per Wikipedia. Not in data until in force.
excluded.Akrotiri and Dhekelia: In the EU customs territory from 2004-05-01 but has no ISO 3166-1 code.
excluded.sub-national: Büsingen, Heligoland, Livigno, Ceuta, Melilla and similar carve-outs are not modelled.
